title: Powered equipment and appliances.
officialText:
Permanently installed equipment and appliances powered by internal combustion
engines and turbines shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s installation instructions and NFPA 37.
SECTION MC 916
POOL AND SPA HEATERS
